design_system.theme: Steel Arena — chunky arcade-military UI: dark steel hero with a CSS tank battle scene, blaze orange accents, khaki paper content sections; visually unrelated to the farm-game candidate style
design_system.font_strategy: Arial Black / Arial Rounded MT Bold / Trebuchet MS display fallbacks for a stencil-like military feel, system sans for body; no external font dependency.
signature_elements: Dark hero with crosshair grid overlay and a CSS-only arena scene: animated tank (aiming barrel, muzzle flash), floating square/triangle/pentagon food shapes, pulsing crosshair, immunity chip, WASD/E/Q control chip
Orange codes spotlight band on the homepage with the four official code chips
Tap-to-copy code cards on /codes/ (navigator.clipboard with fallback)
PHASE chips on the dark progression section
Hay-style orange table headers, numbered step rows, dashed policy callouts shared across subpages
PIL-generated og.png (1200x630) matching the Steel Arena theme
responsive_rules: 375px: single column, full-width CTAs, hamburger nav, arena scene scaled with muzzle/immunity chip hidden, tables scroll inside their wrapper only
768px: single-column hero, two-column grids, non-sticky guide contents
1440px: 1160px content shell, two-column hero, three/four-column grids
html/body overflow-x: clip; verified scrollWidth === viewport width at 375/768/1440 on all 8 pages (24/24)
